regular.prompt:
Production game sprite atlas for HOLLOW OATH 2. Exactly EIGHT SEPARATE full-body monster sprites on TRULY TRANSPARENT alpha background in a precise 4 COLUMNS by 2 ROWS grid. Every cell equal, each monster entirely within central 74% of cell, generous fully transparent gaps and margins, no touching across cells. First row is idle poses of FOUR distinct creatures left to right. Second row repeats the SAME four creatures with SAME designs/colors/proportions in dynamic ATTACK poses. Full bodies and all appendages fit. Three-quarter frontal orientation toward viewer, strong clearly readable silhouettes. Match the attached portrait sheet's CLEAN COLORED FANTASY MANGA direction: crisp confident black ink, simplified graphic shapes, vivid but limited colors, two-tone cel shading. No gouache, paper grain, watercolor, 3D, photorealism, hyperdetail, chibi, overly cute forms or modern equipment. Slight eccentric personality, fantasy menace. No backgrounds, floors, cast shadows, environment, labels, numbers, text, frames, divider lines, effects outside creature silhouette or glow clouds. Idle and attack should have clearly different postures and limb positions, retain same size. Keep heads/feet aligned sensibly within cells. ALL creatures look like adversaries from one polished game.
FOUR CREATURES: column 1 a lean moss-green thorn wolf, dark green fur with large simple ivory root thorns and amber eyes, idle crouching and attack lunging with open jaws. Column 2 an ivory skeleton sentinel in simple worn blue-gray breastplate with a compact round blue shield and spear, idle braced, attack stabbing spear diagonally forward. Column 3 a large charcoal-black ember beetle, three broad orange-red plates on shell and six thick legs, idle low guard and attack raised front legs with jaws open. Column 4 a humanoid burgundy-capped mushroom apothecary with pale stalk face, tiny dark eyes, stubby root feet, dark purple short cloak and one rounded potion vial, idle standing and attack flinging arm holding potion. Not goofy.

bosses.prompt:
Production boss sprite atlas for HOLLOW OATH 2. Exactly EIGHT SEPARATE full-body boss creature sprites on TRULY TRANSPARENT alpha in precise 4 COLUMNS by 2 ROWS equal grid. Each cell entirely independent, every creature within central 72% of cell with wide empty transparent gutters. FOUR DIFFERENT BOSSES, one per column. First row: each boss's FIRST FORM. Second row: same boss TRANSFORMED SECOND FORM. Transformations must be immediately visually striking yet preserve identity. All limbs, horns, wings, weapons fit inside cell. Three-quarter frontal toward viewer, professional high-impact fantasy game enemies matching reference's clean vivid expressive MANGA ink and two-tone cel shadows. Broad elegant readable shapes rather than excessive little details. Limited vivid color per creature, bold silhouette, menacing and eccentric rather than generic. Serious adventure, not chibi or cutesy, no gore. No painterly texture, photorealism or 3D. NO backgrounds, floors, cast shadows, smoke clouds, labels, frames, grid lines or lettering. Transparency genuinely clear. Only creature itself, keep any magical energy compact attached to creature.
COLUMN 1 BRIAR STAG: form1 large emerald-black deer with ivory root antlers, a simple small crown tangled in antlers, thorn armor on chest, four cloven legs. Form2 the same stag rearing upright, antlers become wide branching crimson thorn blades and its chest armor opens to reveal a gold heart, body larger and thornier; keep recognizable head. COLUMN 2 LIVING FURNACE: form1 squat broad black iron armored giant, orange furnace window in belly, huge coal fists. Form2 black outer armor cracked open and falling away, tall lanky incandescent orange molten core with two massive detached black gauntlets, clearly same furnace window. COLUMN 3 PORCELAIN WIDOW: form1 four-legged ivory porcelain spider with regal mask-like face and small dark-blue mantle, thin limbs with simple blue accents. Form2 porcelain carapace splits into eight sharp fan-like panels, revealing a long violet insect abdomen and six sharper jointed legs, cracked white face still visible. COLUMN 4 FROST LEVIATHAN: form1 coiled sky-blue sea dragon with ivory ice dorsal fins, dark navy underbelly, broad finlike forelimbs. Form2 dragon uncoils upward, ice armor splinters into much larger jagged crystalline dorsal blades attached to its body, head crest becomes an ice crown, mouth open, strong sinuous silhouette.
